title: the_parkour_map_my_dad_deleted
display_title: My Dad Deleted My World the Night Before I Went Viral
beats: My dad deleted eleven months of my parkour map the same night a big channel messaged me about it.
I'm 16, and I built that course block by block after school, testing every jump myself, hundreds of times.
He said gaming wasn't a 'real hobby' and wanted to teach me a lesson about priorities before finals.
I showed him the messages the next morning, the creator asking to feature my map to two million subscribers.
He went pale, said he thought I'd just quit and forget it like everything else, and offered to 'talk to someone' for me.
I didn't rebuild it. I just haven't spoken to him the same way since. Was I wrong to let it stay broken?
